name: Shadow Stalker
special: While in play: all players at this tile lose +1 Sanity at Tick.

name: Hollow Spectator
special: On entry: all here lose 1 Sanity.

name: Terror Beak
special: Spawned from Eye of Terror split. Removed if Eye is restored.

name: Spider Thing
special: Multi-attack. Rolls 2 dice.

name: Your Roommate (Wrong)
special: Sanity costs to fight: 1 Sanity per attack die rolled.
art_notes: A familiar shape with too many teeth

name: The Neighbor
special: Cannot be attacked at range.
art_notes: Suburban man in a robe with a cleaver

name: A Howling Outside
special: Atmospheric. All players lose 1 Sanity. Discard.

name: The Power Flickers
special: All Battery-powered Items disabled this Night. Discard.

name: The Doorbell Rang
special: The player at the front-most house tile loses 2 Sanity.

name: Food Gone Wrong
special: Discard 1 Food at this tile (if any).

name: Whispers Behind the Walls
special: Each player at this tile loses 1 Sanity.

name: Lost Memories
special: The player here discards a random Item card. Discard.

name: The Grue (Charlie)
special: Cannot be fought. Resolves Charlie attack at this tile (1d8 Sanity 1d6 Health). Discard after.

name: Lurker
special: Persistent: stays on the tile until cleared.

name: Hungry Dog
special: Persistent: each Tick eats 1 Food at this tile.

name: Cracked Floor
special: Persistent: Move actions out of this tile cost 1 extra Hunger.

name: A Buzzing in Your Head
special: All players roll Sanity d8 / 4 round up Sanity loss.

name: The Lights Cut Out
special: All Flashlights disabled this Night.

name: Voices Calling Names
special: Each player loses 1 Sanity per ally at a different tile.

name: Breathing in the Wall
special: Player at this tile loses 2 Sanity.

name: A Phone Rings
special: No effect. Discard. (You couldn't bring yourself to answer.)
art_notes: Old phone with no caller ID

name: Roaches in the Pantry
special: Discard 1 Food per player at Ellie & Luca's House.

name: The Door at the Back
special: Sealed. Pry to remove (1 action + Crowbar/Lockpick). On removal: gain a free Item from Market.
art_notes: Closed wooden door with light beneath

name: A Child's Shadow
special: Players who attack lose 1 Sanity per attack.

name: Crawling Hand
special: Fast. Attacks the Down player first if any.

name: Black Dog
special: Hunters in pairs. When defeated draw another Threat card.

name: A Stairway Spiraling Down
special: Persistent. Players at this tile may take a Risk action: roll Sanity d8 — 6+ gain a Clue; 1-5 lose 2 Sanity.

name: A Twin Walks Past You
special: The player here loses 3 Sanity. (You don't have a twin.)
art_notes: Two of the same character standee

name: A Friend Bleeding
special: Choose: lose 2 Health to ignore or 4 Sanity to walk past.

name: A Fire That Won't Take
special: All Fire light sources disabled this Night.

name: Fog Bank
special: Persistent: Movement actions at this tile cost +1 action. Visibility zero.
art_notes: Thick grey fog swallowing a street corner

name: The Nest
special: Persistent: At each Night spawns 1 additional Hard threat at this tile. Destroy with 2 actions + 1 Wood (burn it).
art_notes: A pulsing mass of web and bone in a corner

name: Contaminated Water
special: Persistent: No Food can be gathered at this tile. Eating raw food here costs 2 Sanity instead of 1.
art_notes: Dark liquid pooling from a cracked pipe

name: The Locked Room
special: Persistent: One player's Item card is sealed inside. Spend 1 action + Crowbar to recover it. Otherwise lost.
art_notes: A door with seven deadbolts from the inside

name: The Mimic
special: Disguised as a resource token. On reveal: attacks the player who gathered here last. Cannot be attacked at range.
art_notes: A resource token with teeth and one blinking eye

name: Rat Swarm
special: Splits on hit: when reduced to 1 HP it becomes two 1-HP Crawling Hands at adjacent tiles.
art_notes: A tide of tiny dark shapes pouring from a grate

name: The Scarecrow
special: Immune to ranged attacks. While in play: Gather actions at this tile cost +1 Sanity.
art_notes: A straw figure nailed to a fence post with burlap head

name: Something Dripping from Above
special: Player at this tile loses 1 Health. Discard. (You don't look up.)
art_notes: A dark stain spreading across a ceiling

name: The Doppelganger
special: Takes the form of a random player's character. Players must roll Sanity d8 before attacking (5+ = can act; 1-4 = hesitate and lose 1 Sanity).
art_notes: Two identical silhouettes facing each other

name: Wall Crawler
special: Fast: attacks before players can react. Deals damage immediately on draw then fights normally.
art_notes: Something flat moving along the wall like a stain

name: The Glass Child
special: Cannot be attacked with weapons. Must be calmed: spend 1 Comfort item or 2 Sanity to remove. Otherwise deals 2 Sanity damage per Night.
art_notes: A translucent child shape with cracks spreading from its chest

name: The Furnace Woke Up
special: All players at house tiles lose 1 Health from heat. Discard.
art_notes: A basement furnace door glowing orange

name: Every Clock Stopped
special: Day phase ends 1 action early for all players tomorrow.
art_notes: Until next Dawn: all players get -1 action.
column9: A row of clocks all showing different wrong times

name: Roots Through the Floor
special: Persistent: This tile cannot be barricaded. Rest actions here restore nothing.
art_notes: Thick black roots cracking through linoleum and floorboards

name: The Echo
special: Repeat the effect of the last Soft threat that was discarded. If none: lose 1 Sanity.
art_notes: A ripple in the air shaped like a mouth

name: Moth Cloud
special: All light sources at this tile are disabled for the rest of this Night. Discard.
art_notes: A choking cloud of pale moths around a light bulb

name: The Thing in the Attic
special: Can only be fought at house tiles. Retreats to attic between attacks — must spend 1 action to find it before each Fight.
art_notes: A trapdoor in a ceiling with something peering out

name: The Watcher
special: Persistent: While in play all players at this tile cannot trade. It watches. It remembers.
art_notes: A single unblinking eye mounted in a wall like a painting
